voice_profile_origin: Original Klaus Kinski argument with Walter Saxer on the Fitzcarraldo set, reproduced in Werner Herzog's documentary Mein liebster Feind (1999). A locally selected 6.25-second excerpt conditions the synthetic parody voice; the original recording is not bundled.
reference_text_status: German ASR corrected against scene context and published transcription; no human listening verification.

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

runtime_assets: Generated MP3 files and a text-to-file catalog only. No source/reference recordings, service endpoint, model weights, profile path or dependency on VoiceStudio at runtime.
postprocessing: Per-clip constant gain toward -20 dBFS non-silent RMS (-50 dBFS block threshold), capped at -2 dBFS decoded-MP3 peak. Mono 24 kHz, 64 kbit/s MP3; no dynamic compression, pitch shift or time stretch in the asset conversion.

scope.documents: DocSpec.transcript paragraphs displayed by UI.document, and a separate reading of static DocSpec.page paragraphs. No titles. Page-only pencil prefixes and pure separator lines are removed identically in runtime and extraction.
scope.conversations: TalkView.lines[].text from Chapter4, Chapter5 and caliche, including YOU and aside. Not choices, status or reply.
scope.telephone: Canonical literal PHONE_CALLS cue.text except aside, and PHONE_TEXTS from src/core/phoneScripts.ts. Exact speech only; actor labels, quotation marks and the unsaid player aside are excluded. 24 phone texts reuse 15 existing clips and add nine from Ward/Nora in chapters 2 and 3.
scope.telephone_manuscript: production/kinski/telefonmanus.md: all 24 exact authored speech lines by scene and actor, with the unsaid chapter 2 player aside explicitly marked silent.

dynamic_unavailable.reason: Player exposure time is interpolated; both control methods are otherwise finite.
Controller event time is interpolated in the paper.
Solve time is interpolated in the paper.
The paper is built from the changing message list.

dynamic_policy: A requested document or dialogue block is available only when every paragraph/line has matching generated audio. No silent skipping over unknown text.

qa.pcm_encoding: All MP3 re-decoded and ffprobe checked: mono, 24000 Hz, MP3. All catalog IDs/text/hash/durations match corpus and generation report.

asr.interpretation: Original six dispersed samples are preserved. Two added phone samples: Ward has no token edits; Nora has one inflection difference (developed to develop). Numeric/time spelling and a short A/B/C survey passage remain flagged from the original samples. Automatic transcription does not establish audible word accuracy or similarity.

qa.rejected_take: Silent T. take was rejected; final initial uses Tee. A history-recovered first take was regenerated with identical text/seed to capture an explicit dropped_chunks=0 response.

library_reference: prosjektbibliotek/OFFENTLIG_INVENTAR.md entry for debpalash/VoiceStudio. Existing installed local API and profile reused; no new model or service installed.

pronunciation_overrides.reason: The one-letter signature T. returned a silent take. Tee. is the same English letter pronunciation. Catalog text and source text remain unchanged.
